section_summary.extract_value: This section provides the citation details for an article titled "Satisfaction with adult children's achievements is associated with depression and loneliness in later-life: the mediating roles of children's support and gratitude" by Babatola Dominic Olawa & Erhabor Sunday Idemudia, published in 2019 in Educational Gerontology. It includes the DOI and a direct link to the article.
